about_the_game:
Magic Madness: The ultimate PvP experience in VR!
Enter a world where magic isn't just power, it's a way of life. Magic Madness pits up to four players against each other in fast-paced VR battles using the raw powers of fire, water, earth, metal, and wood. Master unique spells, adapt to dynamic arenas, and outwit your opponents in a test of skill, strategy, and reflexes.

 

Five Elements of Magic Madness:  
-Fire: The element of passion, destruction, and transformation. It fuels chaos and intensity, bringing both danger and renewal.

 

-Water: Ever-flowing and adaptable, Water represents wisdom, flexibility, and the power to effortlessly shape its surroundings.

 

-Earth: A foundation of stability and endurance, Earth represents resilience, structure, and the strength to withstand any force.

 

-Metal: Precise and unyielding, Metal symbolizes strategy, discipline, and the relentless pursuit of victory.

 

-Wood: The force of growth, expansion, and creativity, Wood thrives on dynamism and unpredictability.

 

Key Features:
Fast-paced VR Combat - Dodge, throw, and strategize in real-time with intuitive motion-based controls. 
Multiplayer Madness - Take part in 4-player battles with integrated voice chat and tactical team play.
Elemental Arenas - Fight in immersive environments, each shaped by the influence of a specific element.
Custom Skins & Characters - Play as a Crocodile Cowboy, a Cyber Monkey, or other unique characters.

 

Enter the arena, master the elements, and embrace the madness!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9400f
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 Super
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400f
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, OpenXR
